text:
olga: Customer (VenturePharm) reported two invoices for Feb 2025. One invoice is missing the embedding line_items and the other has both but different totals. Ticket #BILL-9801 attached.
billing-bot: reconcile-run completed 2025-05-02T05:00:00Z. Alerts: duplicate_invoice_group for customer_id=VP-55 period=2025-02; mismatch in totals detected.
marc: invoice numbers?
olga: INV-2025-22300 and INV-2025-22300-dup. Customer says INV-2025-22300 (first) shows subtotal $9,120.40, no embeddings; dup has embeddings but total $9,120.73.
priya: quick log tail shows a retry path creating the duplicate while the original was stuck flushing line_items. Also see tax_line missing on the first one. Logs: ```
2025-02-28T23:59:59Z ERROR invoice_writer: flush_line_items timed out (sql timeout)
2025-02-28T23:59:59Z INFO invoice_writer: retrying invoice create (idempotency_key absent)
2025-02-28T23:59:59Z INFO invoice_writer: created INV-2025-22300-dup (line_items attached)
```
marc: that explains duplicate + missing lines, but why the 33cent difference?
priya: rounding + tax calculation order differed between the two creates. The retry path applied tax after rounding per-line instead of aggregating then rounding -> one-cent-per-line drift ended up $0.33. Also currency math handled as floats in two separate code paths.
finance-ops: customer is unhappy and wants a corrected invoice and a credit for the duplicate. Recommend immediate void of the dup and credit, then patch canonical invoice with missing embeddings and correct totals.
olga: approval?
finance-ops: approve manual remediation. Cap refund at $20k. Proceed with void + credit and reconcile canonical invoice. Document everything in ticket.
marc: running ad-hoc remediate: `tools/finance/void_and_credit --invoice INV-2025-22300-dup --reason "retry created duplicate"`
marc: done. Credit CR-7201 issued for $9,120.73, INV-2025-22300-dup voided. Notified CS and customer.
olga: attaching embeddings and recalculating totals on INV-2025-22300 now. Using script: `scripts/finance/attach_missing_lines.py --target INV-2025-22300 --from-usage vp-55-2025-02 --recalc`
olga: done. Recalculated canonical total to $9,120.73 (now matches credit). Updated ticket #BILL-9801.
priya: remediation notes -> root causes: (1) non-atomic invoice + line_items write (db timeout exposed), (2) idempotency key absent when request_id null -> retry created new invoice, (3) inconsistent money rounding/calc between normal and retry paths.
marc: eng action items: - make invoice + line_items a DB transaction - derive fallback idempotency key when request_id null (sha256(customer_id + period + usage_checksum)) - centralize money math in integer cents and unify tax rounding. I'll open PRs.
priya: also add an integration test that simulates sql timeout during attach and asserts no duplicate invoices created and totals identical.
finance-ops: add runbook step: before issuing void/credit, search invoices for same customer+period created within 5 min, compare line_items and totals, then follow void/credit flow. Add alert that surfaces duplicates within 3-minute window.
olga: ticket updated with credit ID, remediation steps, and PR links when available. Filing postmortem BILL-9801-PM. Thanks all. :pray:
